releaseNotes: v8.14.3: Web Novel Cover Propagation & Persistence Engine: 1) Pixiv & Web Importer: extracts metadata and high-res cover art before initiating chapter crawl pools so active sessions and database records maintain cover art throughout download; 2) End-to-End Pipeline Propagation: ensures cover art and metadata seamlessly propagate when sending imported novels from Crawl View or Library to Translator tab; 3) Paused & Resumed Translation Integrity: guarantees cover art is preserved across pause/resume cycles and saved to history upon translation completion; 4) EPUB Packaging: embeds genuine web novel illustration covers directly into generated EPUBs.
